rules.rule: Same shape type + similar geometry pairs even when the names differ.
rules.meaning: PowerPoint's default byObject match is not name-only; `!!` is a hint, not a requirement, for simple shapes.

rules.rule: `!!` cannot force a pair across shape types.
rules.meaning: rect→ellipse with the same `!!track` shows two blobs in the middle: a cross-fade, not one object.

rules.rule: Text boxes pair as shapes; different text does not break geometry.
rules.meaning: Both moved continuously; the text content itself was not measured word-by-word.

rules.rule: A picture frame pairs with a picture of the same frame; media change is not proven.
rules.meaning: Same picture moved continuously. Different media was not colour-tracked and stays open.

rules.rule: Groups pair as groups when the group name/geometry matches.
rules.meaning: The group moved as one blob; ungrouping was not tested.
One blob crossed the frame; >180° and flips stay open.

rules.rule: An entrance effect on the destination object blocks the Morph.
rules.meaning: The destination stayed hidden for the whole video; no object crossed.

rules.rule: An off-slide destination is absent, not staged.
rules.meaning: B object at x=14.5 in produced an empty stage; Morph does not fly it in by itself.

rules.rule: byWord and byChar keep the frame continuous.
rules.meaning: Geometry is continuous; the word/character interpolation was not verified frame-by-frame.

rules.rule: Z-order does not stop the pairing but can hide the object.
rules.meaning: One small blob remained under the foreground; use the object order deliberately.

rules.rule: A Morph adds its duration to the slide advance.
rules.meaning: 45 slides × 2 s = 90 s expected; PowerPoint produced 109.4 s with 15 × 1.2 s Morphs.
